brief.goal: Align workbench dry-run readonly permission with the project guardrail without any platform write.

allowed_writes: Task, Manifest and project control-plane updates
readonly permission runtime code and smoke tests
workflow_cases lifecycle update to cancelled only after zero-action audit
one fresh runtime_truth Job bound to the retained Case
normal readonly evidence, node, skill, draft and Plan records for that fresh Job
forbidden_actions: budget, bid, monitor or OAuth mutation
database schema or workflow_case_summary View changes
Node or Skill status semantic changes
deleting existing Case, Job, Plan or evidence records
persisting raw user transcript, token, secret, Cookie, complete URL, raw payload or raw response
validation_plan: Postgres zero-action audit for duplicate Cases
stop_conditions: implementation requires a platform write or create confirmation
a new fresh Job would be created without the retained case_id
a duplicate Case has one or more platform actions
fresh readonly produces a root blocker other than readonly_permission_required
any sensitive value could enter a public result or project file

validation: Postgres fresh readonly summary and zero-action audit
